audit_items.proof_trace: The guard `!is_supporting_collateral(CoinType)` is only applied on first borrow (line 121-124), but the invariant is maintained by `deposit_ctoken` (line 86-89), which prevents adding collateral when debt already exists. The two guards together enforce mutual exclusion: it is impossible to hold both debt and collateral for the same asset simultaneously, so on any subsequent borrow the collateral flag is always FALSE, making the absent check on the existing-debt path harmless. `split_ctoken` also correctly removes the collateral entry when balance reaches zero, preventing stale `is_supporting_collateral` states.
